title: Alkaline mineral residues from pulp mills as a sustainable and economical alternative to lime fertilizers
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00814J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ethan Woods, Andrew Trlica, Perry Berlin, Sean Bloszies, Alex Woodley, Rachel Cook, William Joe Sagues
Pulp mill dregs and grits (DGs) raised soil pH as effectively as calcite, increased carbon, and emitted less CO2 in acidic Southeastern U.S. soils, indicating a lower-cost, lower-emission alternative to agricultural lime.
